pdf_grand_staff_repair.rule: MIDI family completes a grand-staff template only when the original template is invalid and total geometric row counts agree.

benchmark_conditions.inputs: Same 384 complete sequences and 20965 reference crops, single H100, batch 64, 4 GiB KV cache, context 16384; model startup and PDF preparation excluded.
benchmark_conditions.model_and_mtp_comparison: The initial six runs all used serial signature-image preprocessing.
benchmark_conditions.final_runtime: The selected candidate is measured again with four CPU image-preprocessing workers. Every signature prediction is compared against its serial run.

program_group_repair.provenance: V2 reference manifest; absent MIDI program recovered from its label track, matching evaluate_scores.worker
